description: A 2,000-row synthetic leak benchmark uses pressure, flow, temperature, pipe age and diameter, with 276 positive cases. Unit differences deliberately test transfer across datasets. This resource is provided by El-Zahab, Samer. Coverage is global as described above; spatial resolution, sampling detail and time coverage beyond those stated remain unknown. The provider lists CSV formats or archive containers, accessible through the linked landing page. Licence: CC-BY-4.0. The public page or repository can be accessed free of charge. Limitation: The narrative says CC0 while the repository licence field says CC BY 4.0. Preserve this conflict and obtain clarification before reuse. For simulation, it can supply inputs or comparison evidence. Related catalogue record: model-epanet. This is a thematic comparison, not evidence that the resource was used with that model.
